semiconductor_relevance: High — MDI Taiwan Innovations specializes in cutting and cleaving technologies for high-hardness materials, including semiconductor substrates like SiC and GaN.
summary: MDI Taiwan Innovations Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of processing equipment that focuses on cutting and cleaving high-hardness materials, particularly in the semiconductor sector. Their proprietary SnB (Scribe and Break) technology enables precise processing of substrates, facilitating a transition from R&D to mass production efficiently.
capabilities: Scribe and Break (SnB) processing technology for SiC and GaN substrates
Automated equipment for cutting and cleaving high-hardness materials
Modular processing solutions for flexible production scaling
